name: mcp-bridge
title: MCP Bridge for ChatGPT
description: Host any npm MCP server as HTTP/SSE endpoint for ChatGPT

input.title: MCP Bridge Input
input.description: Paste your Smithery command or JSON config to host as a remote server for ChatGPT.

playgroundCommand.title: Smithery Playground Command
playgroundCommand.description: Paste the playground command from Smithery (e.g., 'npx @smithery/cli@latest run @VapiAI/vapi-mcp-server --playground')

mcpConfig.title: MCP JSON Config
mcpConfig.description: Or paste the JSON config from Smithery (the mcpServers object)
